title: Living crystal orb shown in psychologist's office
summary: Jordan Jose tells of Living crystal orb shown in psychologist's office, about c. 2008 at local psychologist's office, Western New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: local psychologist's office, Western New York

tellings.quote: Okay, it has a defined shell. Uh, it's a literal crystal orb, but the inside of this orb, for lack of a better word, was alive.

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, says that around 2008 he was shown a crystal orb in a local psychologist's office in western New York. He says it had a clear outer shell, but the inside, for lack of a better word, was alive. If true, it would mean something living and unknown was being shown to a child in an ordinary office.
